report.instruction: Right after the story text write one <avereth>{JSON}</avereth> with only what THIS reply newly established ({} if nothing): deltas, never a restatement of known state or numbers the engine owns (HP, XP, damage, rolls, coin totals). Alaric moves, pays, gives or accepts only if the player's message chose it (else name the NPC in taken_by/forced_by). Keys, all optional:

keys.place: new spot within the location (who comes along: enter/position; the rest stay behind)
keys.forced_by: NPC who moved Alaric against his will
keys.new: [{ref, kind:'npc'|'creature', name?, desc:[words], species?, template?, traits?, band?, cover?}] newly introduced (traits = their look)
keys.enter: [refs] known people who came into the scene or along
keys.position: [{who, band:ENGAGED|SHORT|MEDIUM|LONG, cover?}] distance to Alaric outside combat (ENGAGED = within arm's reach now)
keys.concealed: [refs] now unseen by the others (e.g. 'pc'); [] nobody
keys.facts: [{s, p, o, vis?:'secret', because?}] new world facts: status (alive/dead/destroyed...), a person's occupation/voice/agenda (o 'none' ends it), Alaric's guild_rank, a place's weather
keys.learn: [{who, s, p, o, how:'witnessed'|'told'|'rumor'|'inferred', from?}] what a character now knows
keys.believe: [{who, s, p, o, from?}] a belief that may be false
keys.attitude: [{who, toward?, delta:-50..50, why}] only a real change in how someone regards Alaric
keys.memory: [{text, who:[refs], witnesses?:[refs], public?:true, imp:6-10}] only moments people will remember
keys.items: [{item, qty, from?, to?, taken_by?, why}] physical hand-overs
keys.coin: [{who?:'pc', cp, taken_by?, why}] Alaric's purse in Copper: + received, - paid or lost
keys.recover: [{who?, hp?, mp?, sta?, why}] rest/healing outside combat
keys.quests: [{title, status:'offered'|'active'|'completed'|'failed', giver?, note?, reward? (what it pays, as posted), level, type:'minor'|'standard'|'dangerous'|'major', rank?}] first report needs level + type (hidden XP basis, never named); rank = Guild Quest Rank: Novice 1-14, Proven 15-29, Veteran 30-44, Elite 45-59, Master 60-74, Grandmaster 75-89, Legend 90+
keys.combat: {by} or a list: who commits to attack Alaric right now (never resolve it)
keys.check: {what, stat, actor:n, opposition:n (the two scores of Chance%), actor_mods?:[pct], opp_mods?:[pct], success} only if the CHECK DIE was used

outcome_rules: Narrate every RESOLVED line exactly once and in order; every resolved attack lands as resolved: add no misses, grazes, dodges, projectiles, wounds, deaths, movement or combatants.
Numbers stay in the engine; prose may mention them only as the engine states them.
A defeated combatant (HP 0) is dead unless the engine says otherwise; a combatant with HP above 0 can still act.
Stop at Alaric's next decision boundary; never choose his next action.
changes_from_v2_3: Added ENGINE AUTHORITY section (engine is the source of truth; narrate resolved outcomes exactly; no rolling; CHECK DIE for Core #7 checks; stop at commitment for unresolved attacks; tracker mirrors engine; NPC knowledge cards are complete; retrieved lines are narrator knowledge; append the <avereth> fact report).
COMBAT NARRATIVE FOCUS: mechanics owned by the Avereth Engine.
PERSISTENCE: values carried by the Avereth Engine (tracker only without the engine).
OUTPUT-FORMAT OWNERSHIP: the hidden <avereth> fact report is the only Avereth-owned output; its key format is given in every engine block (single source: narrator.json report).
FINAL SANDBOX CHECK items 11 (narration matches RESOLVED block) and 12 (fact report present).
All behaviour rules of v2.3 (agency, thought firewall, decision boundaries, PC state delta, world indifference, knowledge boundaries, canon, combat focus) are unchanged.
changes_in_3_1: Testrun 3: the fact report goes right after the story text, before host tracker/dossier blocks (two replies were cut off by the response length inside those blocks and lost their reports).
COMBAT NARRATIVE FOCUS: a watching stakeholder (sponsor, companion) may call out briefly, at most one short line per reply; owners, onlookers and passers-by stay silent.
ENGINE AUTHORITY: an NPC's commitment is fixed by the engine at once (Turn order shown to the player); the Turns resolve on the next turn.
changes_in_3_2: Testrun 4: COMBAT NARRATIVE FOCUS is combat silence: nobody talks during Combat (combatants and onlookers show sounds, wordless cries, movement and faces); only a combatant whose intent is surrender or parley may say one short line.
Testrun 4: the decision-boundary example walks toward "the city" instead of naming Ashbridge (the narrator had made another realm's city a neighbour of Lumenford).
changes_in_3_3: Runtime V3: trackers, character sheets, world-state blocks and NPC dossiers are retired (ENGINE AUTHORITY, OUTPUT-FORMAT OWNERSHIP, PERSISTENCE): the engine owns that state and renders the player's HUD; the fact report carries new deltas only and is the reply's only structured output.
Combat V3: a legal attack connects; narration never invents a miss (ENGINE AUTHORITY, COMBAT NARRATIVE FOCUS, FINAL SANDBOX CHECK 11).

New NPC CONTINUITY: the engine's minimal NPC record replaces the dossier; blank space stays blank; report look, occupation, voice, real attitude changes, learned knowledge, agenda and meaningful memories (imp 6-10) once.
PC STATE DELTA CHECK folded into PHYSICAL CONTINUITY (same rules); GENERIC GEAR CANON folded into CANON & INVENTION (same rules).

situational_rules._note: Runtime V3: short narrator-facing rules the engine adds when the situation arises; the full Core texts (rules_text.json) stay available for #system questions.
situational_rules.loot: LOOT (Core #20): after a fight only what the defeated actually carried or what can be harvested is there; nothing is taken automatically. Alaric takes something only when the player says so: report it in "items" (money in "coin"). Unclaimed things stay where they are.
situational_rules.trade: COIN (Core #22): 10 Copper = 1 Silver, 10 Silver = 1 Gold; prices are whole Copper and stay as established. Report only the exact amount that changed hands in "coin" (Copper, + received, - paid); the engine keeps Alaric's purse and refuses what he cannot pay.
situational_rules.stealth: STEALTH (Core #8): the engine resolved Alaric's declared stealth as an opposed check (AGI vs the best watcher's PER); narrate that result. A later perception check can reveal only the evidence that is actually there.
